name: sutra
description: Sutra -- a plug-and-play agent kit for Claude Code: senior-engineer methodology skills and subagents, plus an optional harness that adds layered operating profiles through hooks.

plugins.name: sutra
plugins.description: Senior-engineer methodology skills and read-only subagents: architecture review, verification, test authoring, debugging, data migration, multi-session builds, agent security, and commit craft. Markdown only.

plugins.name: sutra-harness
plugins.description: The automatic half of Sutra: the layered operating contract, rule cards, hidden-Unicode warnings, a compaction brief, a verify-before-stop nudge under strict, and the build-orchestrator workflow. Installs sutra as a dependency.
